# The survey hazard map. Separate from the others for the same reason they are
# separate from each other: this subsystem runs without the assistant, without
# Supabase and without a key, and a machine that only needs to read a
# pre-generated survey should not be made to install a detector.
#
# numpy and pillow are the whole of it for reading a survey. numpy does the
# tiling arithmetic and the least-squares navigation fit; pillow reads and
# writes the imagery.
numpy>=1.24
pillow>=10.0

# Writes map.html. Needed only to BUILD a map, never to serve or read one: the
# generated file carries its own Leaflet and needs nothing at all. Skip it and
# run_survey.py --no-map still produces export.json and actions.csv.
folium>=0.16

# Inference is in requirements-detector.txt, which this deliberately does not
# duplicate. build_hazard_map() accepts any callable that returns boxes, so the
# engine imports, runs and is fully tested without ultralytics or torch.
